C1783.title: Humanity Protocol Suffers Identity Infrastructure Breach by North Korean State-Sponsored Hackers
C1783.summary: In June 2026, decentralized identity protocol Humanity Protocol was attacked by a suspected North Korean state-sponsored hacking group, resulting in a loss of approximately $36 million. The attack targeted not only funds but also the infrastructure linking users' palm print biometric data with on-chain identities.
